name: @pipeworx/mcp-tsa-passenger-volumes

tools.name: tsa_checkpoint_volumes
tools.description: Daily U.S. airport checkpoint screening counts (how many travelers TSA screened nationwide each day), sourced from the TSA's own published daily figures. Pass a single `date`, a `start_date`/`end_date` range, or a `year` for the whole year; with nothing, returns the current year to date. Covers 2019-01-01 through roughly yesterday's date in 2026. Returns found:false (not an error) for a date outside that published range. Keyless.

tools.name: tsa_checkpoint_stats
tools.description: Busiest/quietest-day stats (max, min, average, total) for TSA's daily airport checkpoint screening counts over a period — e.g. "busiest travel day of 2026" or "average daily screenings last July". Pass `year`, a `start_date`/`end_date` range, or nothing for the current year to date. Covers 2019-01-01 through roughly yesterday's date in 2026. Returns found:false (not an error) if the period has no published data yet. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tsa-passenger-volumes forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tsa-passenger-volumes pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
